notes.title: Update v1.1.2 out now!

- Fixes issue where new horses disappear after breeding
- Fixed barn flickering

Report any issues you find here. 
Thank you.

notes.title: Race the Developers!
notes.content:
Hello!

Today we are pleased to announce a little contest for Secret of the Magic Crystals! Get your horses ready, as on the 30th and the 31st of August the developers will be heading into the race track to duke it out with you guys (The Community!). You can check the events (and their times) [b][url=http://steamcommunity.com/games/45100/events]here[/url][/b]. Each event will run for roughly 1 - 1 1/2 hours length. (PLEASE NOTE: Steam auto-does your time zone conversion, the time you see is the time that the event occurs in your timezone).

In order to participate you must have The Race! installed, which is on sale now for $2 USD [b][url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/305570/]here[/url][/b]. The base game can also be purchased for %50 off (at $2.50 USD) [b][url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/45100/]here[/url][/b].

As an added bonus, players who can best the developers in a race (and also come first!) will recieve a free key for either the base game of [b]Secret of the Magic Crystals[/b] or a key for [b]Secret of the Magic Crystals: The Race![/b]*.

[i]*Please note you can only win a key once[/i]


[b]The list of Developer in-game names are as follows:
ArteryStudios
 Adam_Artery
[12]_Artery

If you see any of these players in your game, that means you are racing with a developer![/b]

The stakes are high, and the developers are ready. The question is, are you?

notes.title: Update 1.10 out NOW!
notes.content:
Hello!

The update that has been in the beta branch for the last few days has officially gone live! Apologies for the delay, however some large bugs appeared (Which have been dealt with now!) which delayed this release. Patch notes below!

[quote=ArtertyStudios]
Version 1.10, 4th August 2014
[b]+++ The Race (DLC) expansion changes:[/b]

- Leaderboards Support! (Arriving Tuesday, August 12th!) 
- Particles tweaked for better visibility and performance
- Hang on pressing “Leave” during race fixed
- Minimize under Windows doesn’t quit race anymore
- Camera during race now doesn’t go through meshes (collision fixed)
- Numerous performance optimisations
- Small tweaks on maps
- "Magic Crystals" achievement requirements lowered from 50 to 3

[b]+++ Main game changes:[/b]

- Menu button moved to top right and changed to icon from text
- Sound and music play fixed
- Player running out of terrain in training fixed
- Other small tweaks and fixes
[/quote]


Have a great day and we hope you enjoy Secret of the Magic Crystal! ːcloverː

notes.title: Secret of the Magic Crystals - Multiplayer alpha
notes.content:
We need your help! Don't worry, we don't ask for too much. :)

You will be able to try the new racing expansion of Secret of the Magic Crystals for a short period. Your presence and opinion will be a tremendous help for us to create a great racing experience focusing on our beloved magical horses.   

SOTMC: The Race is a multiplayer expansion for the original game which allows you to race with your favourite horse against your friends or the computer. 
Gather your friends and challenge them on the 22nd of May and tell us your opinion or just enjoy the free ride! 

This test does not need any registration or payment, all you need is a webbrowser. The participation in this test doesn't require the original copy of the game. 

Check this page for further information abut the game: 

http://sotmc.arterygames.com

There is also a Facebook event which you can join and also share with friends and invite them to the event:

https://www.facebook.com/SotMCGame
